title: Count the Digits That Divide a Number
summary: For an integer num, count how many of its digits divide num without leaving a remainder.
statement: For an integer num, count how many of its digits divide num without leaving a remainder.
constraints: Inspect each decimal digit occurrence in num.
A zero digit never counts because division by zero is undefined.
Count each nonzero digit that divides num evenly, including repeated occurrences.
reference_solution:
def count_dividing_digits(num):
    return sum(digit!='0' and num%int(digit)==0 for digit in str(num))
hints: Read the decimal representation one character at a time.
Skip zero before converting it into a divisor.
For every other digit, add one when num modulo digit is zero.
This independently tests every digit occurrence against the definition, preserving duplicates.
